correctness.rationale: For mixed stable/unstable Riesz splitting choose unit stable and unstable vectors. Stable orbit shrinks below 1/2, unstable orbit grows above 2 uniformly at large n. Their normalized linear interpolation is a continuous path in unit sphere; by intermediate value a unit vector maps at time n to orbit norm exactly 1, violating uniform small-or-large alternative for ε=1/2,M=2 at arbitrary cutoff. Single-side hyperbolic spectrum gives operator-norm decay or inverse-norm decay and hence expansion. In finite dimension unit-circle eigenvalues defeat the condition. Explicit diagonal formulas a_N²+b_N²=1 and 4^-N a_N²+4^N b_N²=1 hold algebraically for every N≥1 (not just numerical samples). This respects both quantifier interpretations at the offending time.
